title: Whole Longitudinal Ribbed Upright Arm Cactus
description: One newly authored complete stylized static desert cactus. A tall tapered central column and two unequal continuous outward-upward curved side arms have real longitudinal raised ribs and recessed grooves around their entire thick cross-sections, with rounded shrinking crowns and one complete basal ground sole. The higher narrower arm and lower broader elbow branch differ in whole trajectory, not copied paddles or repeated stem count. Unlike the old four thick flattened jointed pads, these are volumetric corrugated columnar skins with continuous bends, no planar paddle-face areoles or flat edge seats. Three closed editable whole bodies with small fixed rooted overlaps form one plant, not three separate assets. No old visible geometry imported. Opaque untextured PBR. One model zero scenes. Stylized exterior without individual spines, not exact botanical species/anatomy, growth, ecology, edible/medicinal, wind, collision, stability or safety claim.
